name: Fish fofos
assumptions: Yield estimated from instructions dividing mixture into 15 portions (serving count).
Total time is sum of active and passive steps: poach 10 min + mixing/forming ~10 min + chill 20 min + frying batches ~20 min.
Haddock classified as fish (allergen true, Pescatarian true).
Breadcrumbs and unspecified 'Flour' (listed as rice flour in one place but generic in ingredients) treated as containing wheat (Gluten-free and Wheat false/true).
No milk, tree nuts, peanuts, shellfish, soy, or sesame in listed ingredients (conservative classification).
Oil for frying estimated at 40g absorbed but does not affect classifications.
instructions:
STEP 1

Put the fish into a lidded pan and pour over enough water to cover. Bring to a simmer and gently poach for 10 minutes over a low heat with the lid on. Drain and flake the fish.

STEP 2

Put the fish, potato, green chilli, coriander, cumin, black pepper, garlic and ginger in a large bowl. Season, add the rice flour, mix well and break in 1 egg. Stir the mixture and divide into 15, then form into small logs. Break the remaining eggs into a bowl and whisk lightly. Put the breadcrumbs into another bowl. Dip each fofo in the beaten egg followed by the breadcrumb mixture. Chill for 20 minutes.

STEP 3

Heat 1cm of oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat. Fry the fofos in batches for 2 minutes on each side, turning gently to get an even golden brown colour all over. Drain on kitchen paper and repeat with the remaining fofos.

STEP 4

For the onion salad, mix together the onion, coriander and lemon juice with a pinch of salt. Serve with the fofos and mango chutney.

ingredients.name: Haddock
ingredients.assumptions: Poached haddock, edible portion only (skin/bones removed during flaking); typical white fish values.

ingredients.name: Potatoes
ingredients.assumptions: Boiled potatoes without skin; standard value for cooked mashed/boiled potato in fishcake recipes.

ingredients.name: Green Chilli
ingredients.assumptions: One medium green chili (approx 45g whole, chopped and fully used).

ingredients.name: Coriander
ingredients.assumptions: 3 tablespoons chopped fresh coriander leaves (approx 15g per tbsp).

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.assumptions: 2 thin slices fresh ginger root (approx 4g total, peeled and minced).

ingredients.name: Flour
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tablespoons rice flour (approx 8g per tbsp; used as binder).

ingredients.name: Eggs
ingredients.assumptions: 3 medium eggs (approx 50g each, whole, used in mix and coating).

ingredients.name: Breadcrumbs
ingredients.assumptions: 75g dry breadcrumbs as listed (standard panko or fine dry crumbs).

ingredients.name: Vegetable Oil
ingredients.assumptions: Oil absorbed during shallow frying (1cm in pan, batches; estimated 40g total absorbed across all 15 fofos based on typical fishcake recipes).
